tiktok.body:
Saving time as a freelancer is more valuable than any amount of money.  So for editing, I'm always using @Captions.  Literally making everything so much easier and for a better quality video! It's honestly a no-brainer! So, try it for yourself! #fyp #captions #editing101 #aiediting
As a creative, I'm always on the move from one shoot to another, which makes it really difficult for me to find time to edit my videos using my laptop. So I decided to edit all my videos on my phone using the captions app. Instead of wasting long painstaking hours, I literally just let AI edit my videos for me when I'm on the train or when I'm walking in between locations or even when I'm eating. So let me show you how I made this video in just a few minutes. I import my footage, hit AI edit, pick a style and it creates a video that not only looks clean, but is actually optimized to perform. It has B roll captions, sound effects, graphics, everything. And the best part is, is that you don't even need to know how to edit at all. And if you're like me and you want control, you can still find to and everything with your chat editing or timeline. It saves me a ton of time. The videos come out better and they perform better too. So honestly, it's a no brainer. So download captions, try AI edit and see how much faster your workflow gets.
